4. HOUSE RULES & TENANT 
RESPONSIBILITIES

House Rules 
By signing, Party B agrees to uphold the following rules. Party A will issue an official warning 
for a first offense; for continued violations Party A reserves the right to terminate the contract 
without further notice. 
• Keep noise to a minimum after 10:00 PM. 
• No smoking indoors; smoking is permitted outside the house or on the rooftop terrace 
where available. 
• No illegal substances, no parties after 10:00 PM; prostitution is prohibited under 
Vietnamese law and is not allowed on the premises. 
• For a party on the premises, inform the other residents in advance and ensure invited 
guests follow the house rules. 
• Respect others and maintain cleanliness in shared areas. 
• Overnight guests are accepted provided Party B informs Party A and supplies the guest 
information needed for registration (passport/visa, etc.). Party B must inform guests of house 
rules and is responsible for their conduct. 
Tenant Responsibilities 
• Keep shared areas tidy and leave no personal belongings in shared spaces. 
• Check out by 12:00 noon on {{END_DATE}}. Late check-out is subject to availability and 
Party A’s agreement. 
• Report damages immediately; Party B is responsible for damages they cause during their 
stay. 
• Report suspicious activity or safety issues. 
• Respect house rules and other tenants. 
• Obtain Party A’s written approval before altering or installing furniture or changing any part 
of the room or shared space. 
• Do not sublet or transfer the lease without Party A’s consent. 
• Follow this contract and Vietnamese law.

Party A Termination before End Date

Party A may terminate immediately without notice if Party B violates rules, causes damage, 
or poses a safety risk after repeated warnings. No refund applies in that case; further

Party B Termination before End Date

replacement lease. 
If Party B gives less than two weeks’ notice or no notice, no refund will be provided.
